lemmas.name: longestIncreasingSubseqLength_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (xs : List Int) (h : longestIncreasingSubseqLength_precond xs), longestIncreasingSubseqLength_postcond xs (let allSubseq := (xs.foldl fun acc x => acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse; let increasingSubseqLens := allSubseq.filter (fun l => List.Pairwise (· < ·) l) |>.map (·.length); increasingSubseqLens.foldl max 0) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro xs h
  unfold longestIncreasingSubseqLength_postcond
  exact Refine.maxlist_nat _ (List.ne_nil_of_mem (a := 0) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨[], List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Refine.allsub_rev_nil_mem xs, by simp⟩, rfl⟩))
